text_block_list.text:
Today, I watch over Admire Vega's training 
once again.

Her body seemed quite heavy. Worried, I 
called out to her—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"……Leave me alone. I can't afford to 
stop."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I have to train more, because I need to 
get even faster."

Admire Vega put on a brave face, but she 
seemed extremely exhausted. Perhaps I 
should reconsider her upcoming race 
schedule...
